metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a credential validation safety rule at session granularity with fail-fast exception escalation pattern. While semantically distinct from BrokenProcessPool handling, it shares the same asset_type (safety_rule), granularity (session), asset_node_id (safety_rule_node), asset_level (2), and method_family (exception_escalation). The candidate demonstrates a complementary initialization-stage validation pattern that strengthens the broader exception escalation framework already established in BrokenProcessPool Exception Handling. The support evidence from Debugging Roadmap confirms this is an active constraint in the codebase. Peer candidates are orthogonal (instrumentation safety, agent failure monitoring, code style enforcement) and do not suggest a split relationship.
